title: 錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群
subcategoryTitle: 水輪機、發電機與水力機電
subcategoryTitleEn: Hydraulic turbines, generators and hydro-mechanical systems
summary: 錦屏二級水電站以四條各長約 16.7 km 的引水隧洞截取雅礱江大河灣約 310 m 的落差，隧洞最大埋深約 2,525 m；課程定量分析截彎取直的水能利用、深埋隧洞的地應力與岩爆、高壓大流量湧水、鑽爆法與隧道掘進機的選擇，以及長隧洞的水頭損失。
summaryEn: Jinping-II captures about 310 m of fall across the great bend of the Yalong River with four headrace tunnels each about 16.7 km long, buried up to about 2,525 m; the course quantifies use of the bend, in-situ stress and rockburst in deep tunnels, high-pressure high-volume water inflow, the choice between drill-and-blast and tunnel boring machines, and head loss in long tunnels.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 穿越 2,500 m 岩石覆蓋的四條 16.7 km 引水隧洞：岩爆、高壓湧水與長隧洞水力
v30FocusEn: Four 16.7 km headrace tunnels beneath 2,500 m of rock: rockburst, high-pressure inflow and long-tunnel hydraulics

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」與「水頭、流量與出力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capturing the fall of a great river bend" and "Head, discharge and output": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Capturing the fall of a great river bend" is correct?
options: 雅礱江繞著錦屏山拐了一個長約 150 km 的大彎，彎道兩端的直線距離只有約 17 km，水位卻相差約 310 m。
要得到三百公尺的水頭，就必須築一座三百公尺高的壩。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: The Yalong loops around Jinping Mountain in a bend about 150 km long whose ends are only about 17 km apart in a straight line yet differ in level by about 310 m.
To obtain three hundred metres of head a dam three hundred metres high must be built.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 雅礱江繞著錦屏山拐了一個長約 150 km 的大彎，彎道兩端的直線距離只有約 17 km，水位卻相差約 310 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Yalong loops around Jinping Mountain in a bend about 150 km long whose ends are only about 17 km apart in a straight line yet differ in level by about 310 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大河灣截彎取直的水能利用：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Capturing the fall of a great river bend: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」如何決定「錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capturing the fall of a great river bend” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 雅礱江繞著錦屏山拐了一個長約 150 km 的大彎，彎道兩端的直線距離只有約 17 km，水位卻相差約 310 m。在彎道上游築一座低閘壩、鑿穿錦屏山把水直接引到下游端，就能以很小的水庫取得巨大的水頭，淹沒與移民都遠少於築高壩。代價是要在兩千多公尺深的山體下開鑿總長近 70 km 的大斷面隧洞，並在大河灣河段保留生態流量。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Yalong loops around Jinping Mountain in a bend about 150 km long whose ends are only about 17 km apart in a straight line yet differ in level by about 310 m. A low barrage upstream of the bend and tunnels through the mountain to its downstream end give a large head with a very small reservoir, with far less inundation and resettlement than a high dam. The price is nearly 70 km of large tunnels under more than two thousand metres of rock, and ecological flow to be kept in the bend. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：4 條引水隧洞平均長約 16.67 km，開挖直徑約 12.4 至 13 m
steps.observationEn: Project file: Four headrace tunnels average about 16.67 km in length with excavated diameters of about 12.4–13 m
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「要得到三百公尺的水頭，就必須築一座三百公尺高的壩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "To obtain three hundred metres of head a dam three hundred metres high must be built." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Capturing the fall of a great river bend”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The Yalong loops around Jinping Mountain in a bend about 150 km long whose ends are only about 17 km apart in a straight line yet differ in level by about 310 m. A low barrage upstream of the bend and tunnels through the mountain to its downstream end give a large head with a very small reservoir, with far less inundation and resettlement than a high dam. The price is nearly 70 km of large tunnels under more than two thousand metres of rock, and ecological flow to be kept in the bend.

knowledge.text: 誤解：要得到三百公尺的水頭，就必須築一座三百公尺高的壩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: To obtain three hundred metres of head a dam three hundred metres high must be built. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 4 條引水隧洞平均長約 16.67 km，開挖直徑約 12.4 至 13 m

quiz.question: 依「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，引用流量 1,830 m³/s、水頭 288 m 時的電站出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Capturing the fall of a great river bend", which value is closest to the station output at 1,830 m³/s and 288 m of head?
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 Q = 1830 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 4,808 MW（引用流量 1,830 m³/s、水頭 288 m 時的電站出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with Q = 1830 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 4,808 MW (station output at 1,830 m³/s and 288 m of head). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 大河灣截彎取直的水能利用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capturing the fall of a great river bend: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Capturing the fall of a great river bend” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 Q = 1830 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 4,808 MW（引用流量 1,830 m³/s、水頭 288 m 時的電站出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with Q = 1830 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 4,808 MW (station output at 1,830 m³/s and 288 m of head). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,289 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 5,289 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4,808 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4,808 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Q with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 Q = 1830 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 4,808 MW（引用流量 1,830 m³/s、水頭 288 m 時的電站出力）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with Q = 1830 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 4,808 MW (station output at 1,830 m³/s and 288 m of head).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,289 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 5,289 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Capturing the fall of a great river bend"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
隧洞在兩千公尺深的地下，那裡的岩石是乾的，不會有水。
以閘壩與廠房的流量、水位量測核算引水流量與發電量，並在大河灣減水河段設水文站核對生態放流是否達到核定值。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two thousand metres underground the rock is dry and holds no water.
Check diverted flow and generation from flow and level measurement at barrage and powerhouse, and gauge the dewatered bend to confirm ecological release meets the approved value.
quiz.explanation: 以閘壩與廠房的流量、水位量測核算引水流量與發電量，並在大河灣減水河段設水文站核對生態放流是否達到核定值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check diverted flow and generation from flow and level measurement at barrage and powerhouse, and gauge the dewatered bend to confirm ecological release meets the approved value. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大河灣截彎取直的水能利用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Capturing the fall of a great river bend: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Capturing the fall of a great river bend” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以閘壩與廠房的流量、水位量測核算引水流量與發電量，並在大河灣減水河段設水文站核對生態放流是否達到核定值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check diverted flow and generation from flow and level measurement at barrage and powerhouse, and gauge the dewatered bend to confirm ecological release meets the approved value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：引水式電站的核准文件要把生態放流量、放流設施與線上監測列為運轉的前提條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Approval of a diversion scheme should make ecological release, release facilities and on-line monitoring preconditions of operation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若枯水期為了發電而壓低生態流量，150 km 的減水河段水深與流速不足，魚類棲地破碎化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If ecological flow is squeezed for generation in the dry season, depth and velocity in the 150 km dewatered reach become insufficient and fish habitat fragments. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以閘壩與廠房的流量、水位量測核算引水流量與發電量，並在大河灣減水河段設水文站核對生態放流是否達到核定值。
knowledge.textEn: Check diverted flow and generation from flow and level measurement at barrage and powerhouse, and gauge the dewatered bend to confirm ecological release meets the approved value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 引水式電站的核准文件要把生態放流量、放流設施與線上監測列為運轉的前提條件。
knowledge.textEn: Approval of a diversion scheme should make ecological release, release facilities and on-line monitoring preconditions of operation.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Capturing the fall of a great river bend" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若枯水期為了發電而壓低生態流量，150 km 的減水河段水深與流速不足，魚類棲地破碎化。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: If ecological flow is squeezed for generation in the dry season, depth and velocity in the 150 km dewatered reach become insufficient and fish habitat fragments.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 若枯水期為了發電而壓低生態流量，150 km 的減水河段水深與流速不足，魚類棲地破碎化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If ecological flow is squeezed for generation in the dry season, depth and velocity in the 150 km dewatered reach become insufficient and fish habitat fragments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 大河灣截彎取直的水能利用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Capturing the fall of a great river bend: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大河灣截彎取直的水能利用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Capturing the fall of a great river bend” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若枯水期為了發電而壓低生態流量，150 km 的減水河段水深與流速不足，魚類棲地破碎化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If ecological flow is squeezed for generation in the dry season, depth and velocity in the 150 km dewatered reach become insufficient and fish habitat fragments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是要在兩千多公尺深的山體下開鑿總長近 70 km 的大斷面隧洞，並在大河灣河段保留生態流量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is nearly 70 km of large tunnels under more than two thousand metres of rock, and ecological flow to be kept in the bend.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「要得到三百公尺的水頭，就必須築一座三百公尺高的壩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "To obtain three hundred metres of head a dam three hundred metres high must be built." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若枯水期為了發電而壓低生態流量，150 km 的減水河段水深與流速不足，魚類棲地破碎化。
knowledge.textEn: If ecological flow is squeezed for generation in the dry season, depth and velocity in the 150 km dewatered reach become insufficient and fish habitat fragments.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 2007：主體工程開工
knowledge.textEn: 2007: Main works began

quiz.question: 關於「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head, discharge and output" is correct?
options: 壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
水輪機型式只由水頭決定，與流量和轉速無關。
水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。
optionsEn: The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Turbine type is decided by head alone, independent of discharge and speed.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head, discharge and output” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.question: 依「水頭、流量與出力」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，額定工況的單機電氣出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Head, discharge and output", which value is closest to the electrical output of one unit at rated conditions?
options: 601 MW
300 MW
optionsEn: 601 MW
300 MW
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 228.6 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 601 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 228.6 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 601 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭、流量與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head, discharge and output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 228.6 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 601 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 228.6 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 601 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 661 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 661 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 601 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 601 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 228.6 m³/s、H = 288 m、η = 0.93，得 601 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 228.6 m³/s, H = 288 m, η = 0.93 the result is 601 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 661 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 661 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head, discharge and output"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
隧洞只要能通水就好，洞壁光不光滑不影響發電。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.
A tunnel only has to carry water; whether its walls are smooth does not affect generation.
quiz.explanation: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭、流量與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head, discharge and output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.

knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60041 Field acceptance tests to determine the hydraulic performance of hydraulic machines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「水頭、流量與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head, discharge and output" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
水輪機型式只由水頭決定，與流量和轉速無關。
若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Turbine type is decided by head alone, independent of discharge and speed.
Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output.
quiz.explanation: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭、流量與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Head, discharge and output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「錦屏二級深埋引水隧洞群」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Jinping-II Deep Headrace Tunnels, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
